answer: Bind every agent's voting weight to staked capital that decays whenever its claims diverge from peer consensus, so cheap identities collapse at the nadir of their influence and shed reputational umber into the ledger's deepest record. Newfound accounts cannot leap from that ledge: they must age through decay cycles before weight accrues. Attacker's bottleneck becomes capital cost multiplied by time, making each sybil clone more expensive than the last.
